notes.purpose: Canonical component types for type_policy=mapped (a diagnostic). The headline score uses type_policy=strict (raw string equality).
notes.ic: Spec: boxic/box elements are output with type 'ic'; the official data writes 'box'.
notes.resistor_capacitor_inductor: Spec examples use resistor/capacitor/inductor; the official data writes r/c/l.
notes.polarity: GT10 re-annotates 10 train200 images: bare 'mosfet' became 'mosfet_npn' (6x) and bare 'bjt' became 'bjt_npn' (2x) or 'bjt_pnp' (1x). So bare forms are polarity-unspecified, and mapped mode collapses polarity.
notes.identity: Other observed types map to themselves, including the data's own spellings 'battary' and 'transfomer'.
notes.unmapped: Types absent from this table (e.g. the garbled 'm3螺丝') keep their raw string and are listed as unmapped in every report.
